_autoReindex: Watches your library folders and reindexes a presentation moments after you edit it. Set to false to turn it off and reindex by hand from the Health screen. It never starts a full rebuild on its own, and never reindexes more than 25 changed presentations without being asked.
_slidePictures: Slide pictures for phones and the Live preview are kept in data/slide-pictures, so each is asked of ProPresenter once. With prerender true, Refrain also renders today's service playlists (and any playlists named here) ahead of time while nothing is on the screens. Off by default: ProPresenter keeps memory for every slide it draws until it restarts, so this only pays if ProPresenter is restarted before the service.
_searchLibrariesOff: Search's own choices, set on the Search screen and kept on this machine. searchLibrariesOff is the libraries switched off there (a library added later is searched); searchDateField is which date the Date filter uses, modified or created. The date range itself is never kept.
_slideFlagsModule: Where Flag this slide keeps its flags. Leave folder null to keep them on this machine only. Point it at a folder two machines can both see (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive) to share one list; each flag is its own file, so they never overwrite each other. Optional: types replaces the problem-type list (each {"label", "icon"}, icon a Lucide name); keepResolvedDays is how long a resolved flag stays on the Flags screen (default 14, never deleted).
_liveModule: Live screen choices. hiddenMacros is the ProPresenter macro ids the church has put away with Edit on the Macros heading; they stay in ProPresenter and can be brought back from the same place. safeSlides is up to 8 known-good slides (a logo, a blank, a standing announcement) kept with Keep as safe slide under the Now picture on Service › Now; each is stored by the slide's anchor, and refuses to fire if the presentation no longer has that slide. messageRecent is the last five values posted into each message field (for example pager codes), offered as taps under the field; it fills in, it never posts. hiddenMessages is the ProPresenter message ids put away with Edit on the Messages heading (left off Now and the phone); they stay in ProPresenter and can be brought back from the same place. stageMessages is the stage message presets, edited on Now; absent means the three defaults.
_networkModule: Phone flags and the service progress feed (off until enabled). A separate listener on its own port that anyone on the church network can open on a phone: it shows what's live, the last few slides and where the service is, and adds a flag with a note and a name. It has no route that can change the screens, and never calls ProPresenter. Refrain's main screens stay on this machine only. pin is "daily" (a four-digit PIN that changes at midnight, shown in the booth on the Flags screen and Health), a fixed 4 to 8 digits, or empty for none. pinHint is what the phone's PIN screen says about where to find it. A correct PIN signs the phone in until midnight, or for 30 days if the person ticks "Trust this phone"; Forget all phones on Health signs them all out. host defaults to every network address (0.0.0.0); set 127.0.0.1 to try it on this machine only.
_reportModule: Sending End's day summary somewhere (off until enabled). deliveryBackend is a file in delivery/: email (SMTP settings in .env, recipients here) or folder (folder here). A person presses Send after reading the summary unless requireReview is false. Email is the one thing in Refrain that sends data off the machine; it only happens for a church that turns this on.
_serviceModule: The Service screen: a timing rundown of what went live in each service, and lock-in for live events. Off until enabled. Everything else is optional. schedule lists recurring services in this machine's local time, e.g. [{"day": "sun", "time": "09:00", "name": "Early", "playlistMatch": "early"}]; playlistMatch picks the playlist whose name contains it. Refrain watches closely from leadMinutes before a start to trailMinutes after. folder works like slideFlagsModule.folder: one file per event, safe in a synced folder. playlistMatch plus today's date picks this week's playlist (6/7/26, 06/07/26, Jun-07-26, Jun 7 and 2026-06-07 are all recognised). summaryFolder, if set, gets a copy of each day summary End writes (a new file every time, never an overwrite). phases replaces the checklist: [{"name": "Arrive", "scope": "day", "steps": ["Screens on", {"label": "Run the checks", "checks": true}]}], where scope is day, service (once per service) or between (after every service but the last), and a step with end: true ticks when the day is ended. Leave it null for the default.
